answer: A bonded-identity escrow turns each new agent into a quartz-hard financial commitment: before earning any nectar, an identity must lock 500 governance tokens, roughly $75, into a slashing contract. First, the agent registers and its deposit is escrowed on-ledger. Second, each epoch a verifier samples the agent's task grades and compares them against the median consensus of at least 21 peers; divergence beyond a yarrow threshold, say 1.5 standard deviations, triggers a challenge window.
